reviews.title: It's not what I wanted but it's what I needed!
reviews.comment:
I'm extremely proud of this keyboard, not because it has everything I wanted in a portable keyboard but because it did the one thing the others I desired couldn't do.
The weight is perfect. It feels like durable and quality material. The key layouts are perfect; I can jump in and out of typing quickly. Super easy to power on and initial setup and connectivity is simple.
Now let's talk about why this is a win for me:
What I wanted in a portable keyboard was something foldable, connects with a dongle, rechargeable, and perfect key response. I've made 4 purchases and returned each. Remembering Logitech is actually good with small devices I did some research but couldn't find what I wanted. So I checked out what they offered. This keyboard offered none of the options I wanted... except one and it was the most important: responsiveness. It doesn't fold but it's compact enough to where I can tuck it out of sight. It's Bluetooth and I was fearful is a dongled device was gonna give me bad keystroke response, this was gonna be worse...but I was wrong. I almost didn't buy it for it being powered by batteries but I have a really good set of rechargeable AAAs to stay in the game. Finally keystroke response. I've had this for weeks and it has not given me an issue yet when my previous purchases showed their true colors within days. I am more than happy with this purchase. Go on ahead and invest in some rechargeable AAAs and but this keyboard; I'm glad I did!
reviews.author: C. Wilson

reviews.title: Quiet, easy to use, little but the perfect size! I love It!!!
reviews.comment: I love this keyboard. I was a bit apprehensive at first because I thought I needed my 10-key numbers but I could not be happier. It is very soft and quiet. There is no clicking and the round buttons make it easier to type and not make typing mistakes. The Bluetooth connection has never been problematic at all. The buttons do not stick. It’s worth the investment. Great quality!
reviews.author: Yana

reviews.title: Confusion about Unifying...cleared up by Bolt.
reviews.comment: First off, this is a nicely made keyboard and works really well with Bluetooth on Windows machines. It will work really well right after setup on Linux but after a reboot will not automatically switch in. I had a similar issue with a M720 mouse and resorted to using the Unifying Receiver that came with it. I figure I would get the same behavior with the K380s so I tried to connect it to the same Unifying Receiver. (I dual boot with Windows 11 and used the Logitech software for the attempt.) It was a NO GO. No manner of Unifying software or disabling the Bluetooth would get it to connect. I have seen conflicting info online about whether it works and I can tell you I tried to connect mine to 3 different Unifying Receivers on two different Windows 11 systems and the K380s will not connect. I have seen word that the Bolt Receivers are the way to go....I'm not convinced. Logitech Support info is sketchy on the subject and I don't believe half the people on Reddit that insist you can connect it to a UR. The Logi Options+ software will show the mouse and keyboard but only the mouse is using the UR, the keyboard has the Bluetooth icon. The check on that is when you turn off Bluetooth in Settings the mouse keeps working and the keyboard stops. Now I have to solve the debate in my head as to whether this thing gets returned.....sigh. Amended 9/22: I solved the receiver problem. I bought an M550L from Amazon that came today. It was equipped with the Bolt Receiver. When I ran the Logi Options+ on Windows 11 looking for the K380s and it took all of 2 seconds to find it. The two work like champs in Ubuntu 24.04.01. The small size and the utility now that the receiver issue is solved makes this K380s a great addition to my complicated office environment and takes two other keyboards out of the crowded picture.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Great produce.
reviews.comment: Fantastic keyboard. Had my keyboard fail on my laptop  and rather than trying to fix it, I opted for this. Small,  quick action on the keys and fits over my laptop keyboard easy and paired instantly.  Also so light and the Pebble keys feel good when typing which I do a lot of since I am a writer.
reviews.author: jack t.

reviews.title: Great for traveling
reviews.comment: This keyboard is small, compact, and easy to travel with. It slides right into my backpack and is basically plug-and-play. No crazy setup needed, just turn it on and it’s good to go. Great keyboard to have if you move around or travel a lot.
